Polishing involves removing the thinnest layer of clear coat along with the scratches. This layer is not endless, so we start with a thickness gauge: we measure each panel and assess how much material is left. If the clear coat is already thin on the roof or fenders—we work more gently or leave the panel untouched.

Next, we perform two or three passes: a cutting compound removes major defects, and a finishing compound eliminates holograms from the machine. The result is inspected under a lamp, which reveals what is not visible outdoors. Only after this do we degrease and apply ceramic. We use Koch-Chemie compounds for polishing, and apply Gtechniq for the ceramic.

The main value of the film is not 'shine,' but preserved factory paint. Repainted fenders are detectable by any thickness gauge, and this is an immediate price deduction during inspection before purchase. The film absorbs impacts instead of the clear coat: minor scratches on it self-heal in sunlight, deep scratches remain on the film, not on the body.

We cut patterns specific to your vehicle using a plotter, and for complex areas—bumpers, mirrors, pillars—we fit manually. Where the panel allows, we tuck the edge inside: this way, the seam doesn’t collect dirt and doesn’t reveal itself with a thin gray stripe after a year.

We source films from XPEL and SunTek. We will specify which one suits your car during the inspection—before you agree to the estimate.

src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.4a0e4d9d8022611c:
Another BMW X5 wrapped in transparent **PPF film**. The film takes the hit from what would otherwise damage the paint: gravel, sand, bug splatter, and small scratches that accumulate during daily driving. We highly recommend protecting the headlights as well. Here’s what that offers from the front:
  • stones and road debris won’t reach the glass
  • No scratches or pitting
  • Ultra-violet rays are blocked by the film, keeping the plastic from yellowing or clouding over time
  • Expensive LED and adaptive optics maintain their factory appearance
The rear is a simpler task:
  • No scratches or minor damage
  • Tail lights stay clear and shiny for longer
The headlights are one of the most vulnerable parts of a car. Year after year, stones, sand, dust, car wash brushes, and UV rays wear down the surface of the optics. The film provides an additional layer between them and the plastic, absorbing most of the impact. You can wrap the entire car, just the front, specific body parts, or just the optics.
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.73c62b86675348af:
Još jedan BMW X5 pod prozirnom **PPF folijom**. Folija preuzima ono što bi na drugačiji način zahvatilo lak: kamenčiće, pesak, tragove insekata i sitne ogrebotine koje vozilo stiče u svakodnevnoj vožnji. Posebno preporučujemo zaštitu farova. Šta to donosi napred:
  • kamenčići i saobraćajni otpad ne dolaze do stakla
  • nema ogrebotina i peskarenja
  • ultraljubičaste zrake se zadržavaju folijom, plastika duže ne požuti i ne zamagli
  • skupa LED i adaptivna optika zadržava fabrikaški izgled
Pozadi je zadatak jednostavniji:
  • nema ogrebotina i sitnih oštećenja
  • lampa duže ostaje prozračna i sjajna
Farovi su jedno od najranjivijih mesta na automobilu. Kamenčići, pesak, prašina, četke na pranju i sunce godina na godine uništavaju površinu optike. Folija stavlja dodatni sloj između njih i plastikom, uzimajući na sebe većinu udarca. Mogu se zaštititi celu vozilo, samo prednji deo, pojedini elementi karoserije ili samo optika.

The new Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 came to us with two tasks: to protect the body and to change its appearance to satin. Together with the owner, we selected a protective satin film with a thickness of **190 microns**, covering the entire body. Under the film, the factory paint remains untouched: minor scratches, stone chips, insect residue, chemicals, and road grime no longer reach it. The satin finish alters how the car looks in the light, while the original color remains protected underneath. We fold the edges of the parts where it's technically possible: fewer visible edges result in a more cohesive look, and the film lasts longer. The film can be repaired locally. If a part gets damaged over time, it's usually unnecessary to rewrap the whole vehicle — just the affected part is replaced. The benefits of a full wrap include:
  • The factory paint doesn’t accumulate chips or minor scratches
  • Road grime and chemicals stay on the film
  • It’s easier to maintain the body
  • A damaged element can be replaced separately
  • The new car is protected from the first kilometers
  • The preserved paint is noticeable when selling
  • Satin appearance without repainting
We perform PPF wrapping in Belgrade, in the Zvezdara area. You can wrap both a new car and one that has been driven: either completely or just the most vulnerable elements. We'll choose the type of film during the inspection. We will showcase the result of the full satin film wrap for the GLS once it's completed.
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.f124fec51f69960f:
Novi Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 je došao kod nas sa dva zadatka: zaštititi karoseriju i promeniti izgled na satenski. Zajedno sa vlasnikom smo odabrali zaštitnu satensku foliju debljine **190 mikrona**, oblačimo celu karoseriju. Pod folijom fabrička lakirna površina ostaje netaknuta: sitne ogrebotine, kamenčići, tragovi insekata, hemikalije i saobraćajna prljavština više ne dospevaju do nje. Satenska folija menja način na koji se auto doživljava na svetlu, dok originalna boja ostaje za zaštitnim slojem. Ivica detalja se podvija gde je to tehnički moguće: vidljivih ivica je manje, slika je celovitija, a obloga duže traje. Folija se može lokalno popraviti. Ako se tokom korišćenja ošteti jedan deo, obično nije potrebno recimo oblačiti ceo automobil — folija se menja samo na njemu. Šta donosi kompletna obloga:
  • fabrika lak ne skuplja kamenčiće i sitne ogrebotine
  • saobraćajna prljavština i hemikalije ostaju na foliji
  • lakše je održavati karoseriju
  • oštećeni element se posebno prekrije
  • nova mašina je zaštićena od prvih kilometara
  • očuvana lakirana površina, koja se vidi prilikom prodaje
  • satenski izgled bez ponovnog farbanja
Oblogu PPF folijom radimo u Beogradu, na Zvezdari. Može se obložiti i nova mašina, kao i ona koja je već vozila: potpuno ili samo najosetljiviji delovi. Opciju folije ćemo odabrati prilikom pregleda. Rezultat kompletne obloge GLS satenskom folijom ćemo pokazati kada završimo.

Toyota Yaris GR Sport naše klijentkinje iz Beograda. Automobil je kupljen korišćen, ali u odličnom stanju, a nova vlasnica je odlučila da ne čeka prve gradske ožiljke, već da zaštiti karoseriju odmah.

Yaris je kompaktan automobil pogodan za grad, a u gradu karoserija najviše trpi: uska parking mesta ispred prodavnica i tržnih centara, susedni automobili, nepažljivo otvorena vrata, kolica iz supermarketa, grančice i kamenčići sa puta. Najgore je dobiti udubljenje ili ogrebotinu samo zato što je komšija na parkingu otvorio vrata malo šire nego što bi trebalo.

Zbog toga je karoserija oblepljena u potpunosti - zaštitnom poliuretanskom folijom debljine **190 mikrona**.

PPF postavlja čvrst proziran sloj na lak i upija male ogrebotine, strugotine, tragove lakih kontakata pri parkiranju, kao i prašinu i kamenčiće sa puta. Ovo je najpotrebnije za vrata, krila, branike i retrovizore: oni su neprekidno u riziku. Dobra prozirna folija gotovo da se ne primećuje - boja, sjaj i izgled karoserije ostaju isti.

PPF ne pretvara automobil u oklopno vozilo i ne štiti od ozbiljnih udaraca ili dubokih udubljenja. Ipak, redovne gradske oštećenja, koja se vremenom akumuliraju na umornom laku, ona drži pod kontrolom.

Yaris je otišao u svom fabričkom izdanju, samo što je sada karoserija mnogo bolje pripremljena za svakodnevni gradski život.
src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.918eed0479db29d7:
This is a Toyota Yaris GR Sport belonging to our client from Belgrade. The car was purchased used but is in excellent condition, and the new owner decided not to wait for the first city marks and to protect the body right away.

The Yaris is a compact city car, and in the city, the body takes the most beating: tight parking spaces near shops and malls, neighboring vehicles, doors carelessly opened, supermarket trolleys, branches, and stones kicked up from the road. It’s especially frustrating to get a dent or chip simply because the neighboring car door was opened a bit wider than it should have been.

That’s why the entire body was covered with a protective polyurethane film that is **190 microns** thick.

The PPF adds a robust transparent layer on top of the paint, absorbing fine scratches, scuffs, marks from light parking contacts, road sand, and stones. This is particularly important for doors, fenders, bumpers, and mirrors, which are always at risk. A good transparent film is nearly invisible, allowing the color, shine, and appearance of the car to remain unchanged.

While PPF doesn’t turn the car into an armored vehicle, and it won’t protect against serious impacts or deep dents, it does shield the vehicle from common urban damage that can wear down the paint over a couple of years.

The Yaris left in its factory condition, but now the body is much better prepared for the rigors of daily city life.
